_instructions: Add each group member as one object inside the people array below.
The website ignores this _instructions section, so you may keep it here.
Each person's name must be unique. The website uses it automatically to open the correct profile page.
role: their role in the group, such as Undergraduate Researcher or Faculty Advisor.
interests: optional research interests. These appear on the person's profile page, not on their People card.
photo: optional path to their image, for example assets/images/people/jane-smith.jpg.
status: optional. Leave it out for present members; use alumni only for former members.
orcid: optional ORCID iD, written as 0000-0000-0000-0000. It enables the publication updater and View papers on ADS link for that person.
website: optional full URL for a personal or professional website, such as https://example.com. This creates a Personal website link on their profile page.
